**They are the same repo** — identical git origin (`superelastic/claude-session-memory-template.git`) and shared root commit (`d371da6`). But they've **diverged significantly**:

| | `claude-session-memory-template` (original) | `claude-session-memory-template-update` (this) |
|---|---|---|
| **Commits** | 11 total (stopped at `698396c`) | 26 total (continued from same base) |
| **Architecture** | Plain template with `.claude/hooks/`, `install.sh` | **Claude Code plugin** with `.claude-plugin/`, skills, commands, MCP server |
| **Hook system** | `.claude/hooks/session-start.sh` + `session-end.sh` | `hooks/hooks.json` (plugin hook format) + entry-point scripts |
| **Session flow** | Archive → markdown → `git add` directly | Archive → **pending queue** → agent summarization on next start |
| **Discovery** | Manual `install.sh` setup | Plugin install via `/plugin add`, marketplace.json |
| **Extra features** | — | MCP server (`mcp_server.py`), semantic search, SKILL.md, slash commands (`/setup`, `/search`, `/session-end`), migration script from old template |
| **Protocols** | `.claude/STARTUP_PROTOCOL.md`, etc. | Replaced by `skills/session-memory/SKILL.md` + `references/` |

**In short**: This project (`-update`) is the **plugin rewrite** of the original template. The original is the old-style template that users clone/install manually; this one converts it into a proper Claude Code plugin with the pending queue pattern, MCP server, progressive disclosure, and marketplace support.

The original repo is essentially superseded by this one. You probably want to push this as the new version of the same repo (or archive the old one).
